verdicts.title: Pause-freeze check flags Restart reset (by design)
Restart level leaves game paused with no pause menu; game is stuck
Dash and step in the same tick both move the player (3 tiles)
Toast covers the pause menu's Resume button
Keys pressed after pause in the same tick still move the player
HUD coin counter stays stale after collecting a coin
Spike damage at low score wraps the score around instead of flooring at 0
HUD timer freezes at 290 while the game timer keeps counting down
